incident: Terminal closure for merged PR #2306 failed after production and exact migration readback were already true because its direct Supersedes metadata pointed at closed, unmerged PR #2298, which also contained a Supabase migration path.
root_cause: The recovery lineage mixed delivery-history ancestry with production migration authority. Closed unmerged recovery attempts were kept inside the direct Supersedes chain even though only merged predecessors can be authoritative for terminal production migration identity.
prevention_rule: For migration-bearing obligations, direct Supersedes used by terminal delivery must follow merged production-authority ancestry. Closed unmerged recovery attempts remain explicit audit history, but must not be migration-authority nodes in the terminal Supersedes chain.

canonical_metadata_pattern.direct_supersedes: last merged predecessor in the same obligation lineage
canonical_metadata_pattern.unmerged_recovery_history: separate audit metadata such as Unmerged-Recovery-History
canonical_metadata_pattern.terminal_behavior: fail closed when an unmerged direct Supersedes still carries Supabase migrations
